mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the CPIAUCSL index predicts rising inflation expectations, compressing real returns on equities and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not show sustained upward trend, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4.0% triggers increased labor market confidence, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 4.0% within the next month, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in FEDFUNDS and rising quarterly GDPC1 demand signal accommodative monetary policy and robust economic activity, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS < previous and GDPC1 > previous
failure_condition: The FEDFUNDS/GDPC1 combination does not occur as predicted, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS rates signals reduced policy tightness, lowering risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The late-cycle expansion regime is not active, or FEDFUNDS decline does not correlate with positive 20-day returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An abrupt surge in INDPRO supply index above 105 indicates potential overproduction, reducing profit margins and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not exceed 105 within the next month, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High labor demand (PAYEMS > 150k) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) creates a labor market tightness that drives corporate growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The labor demand/unemployment combination does not occur as predicted, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in FEDFUNDS rates signals higher policy rates, elevating interest costs and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The tightening cycle regime is not active, or FEDFUNDS rise does not correlate with negative 5-day returns (t-test p > 0.05).
